name: Python
description: Modern Python idioms, OOP, generators, decorators, memory management, and GIL.

questions.prompt: What is the key advantage of a generator expression over a list comprehension in Python?
options: It executes in parallel across CPU cores
It produces values lazily on-demand without loading the whole list into memory
questions.explanation: Generators evaluate items lazily via the iterator protocol, conserving RAM when handling massive or infinite sequences.

questions.prompt: In Python, what is the default behavior when passing a mutable object (like a list) as a default parameter value in a function definition?
options: A new list is created on every call
The same list object is shared across subsequent calls
Python raises a TypeError at parse time
The list becomes an immutable tuple
questions.explanation: Default argument expressions in Python are evaluated once when the function definition is executed, leading to a persistent shared object.

questions.prompt: What does the Global Interpreter Lock (GIL) in CPython prevent?
options: Multiple threads from executing Python bytecode simultaneously on separate cores
Multiple processes from sharing disk files
questions.explanation: The GIL ensures that only one native thread executes Python bytecode at any given moment, making CPU-bound multi-threading single-core in CPython.
